simple.meaning: יְחֻבָּה (Yᵉchubbâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jechubbah , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יְחֻבָּה (H3160) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Chronicles 7:34, with occurrences in 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יְחֻבָּה (H3160) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יְחֻבָּה (H3160) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יְחֻבָּה (Yᵉchubbâh) / H3160 is traced through 1 Chronicles 7:34 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
